mapper.select: SELECT bs.BAL_FLAG FROM BOK_SUBJECT bs , BOK_BOOKSET bb WHERE bb.BOOKSET_ID =#{booksetId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**账套代码**/ AND bs.SUBJECT_NO = #{subjectNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**科目号**/ AND bs.BOOKSET_ID = bb.BOOKSET_ID_TMPL
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM BOK_STAT_BOK_POSITION WHERE BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} /**账套代码**/ AND HAPPEN_DATE = #{happenDate} /**发生日期**/ AND BOOK_DATE = #{bookDate} /**入账日期**/
select PARAM_CODE, PARAM_VALUE from BOK_BOOKSET_EXT where BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} and PARAM_CODE in ('IS_COMB_TRA_VOUC','IS_COMB_SUP_VOUC','IS_COMB_SUP_REC')

SELECT TEMP.* FROM ( SELECT cur.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY cur.BOOKSET_ID, cur.TRADE_ID, cur.BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE ,cur.O_CCY ORDER BY cur.BOOK_ORDER desc) as rn, book.BOOKSET_DATE BOOKSET_DATE_NEW FROM BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT cur INNER JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_DATE book ON book.BOOKSET_ID = cur.BOOKSET_ID WHERE cur.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} AND cur.BOOK_DATE <= #{bookDate} AND cur.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} ) TEMP WHERE TEMP.rn = 1

WITH voucher AS ( SELECT TEMP.happenDate, /**发生日期**/ TEMP.booksetDate, /**账套日期**/ TEMP.bookDate, /**入账日期**/ TEMP.bookId, /**凭证编号**/ TEMP.booksetId /**账套代码**/ FROM ( SELECT cur.HAPPEN_DATE as happenDate, /**发生日期**/ cur.BOOKSET_DATE as booksetDate, /**账套日期**/ cur.BOOK_DATE as bookDate,/**入账日期**/ cur.BOOK_ID as bookId,/**凭证编号**/ cur.BOOKSET_ID as booksetId, /**账套代码**/ cur.OFFSET_FLAG as offsetFlag, /**冲正标识**/ ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY cur.BOOKSET_ID, cur.BOOK_ID ORDER BY cur.BOOK_ORDER desc) as rn FROM BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT cur WHERE 1=1 AND cur.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} /**账套代码**/ AND cur.BOOK_DATE <= #{bookDate} /**入账日**/ AND cur.TABLE_ID = #{tableId} /**场景代码**/ AND cur.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} /**交易编号**/ AND cur.HAPPEN_DATE = #{happenDate} /**发生日**/ AND cur.HAPPEN_DATE >= #{beginHappenCycDate} AND cur.HAPPEN_DATE <= #{endHappenCycDate} AND decode(cur.cd_flag,'D',1,'C',-1,0)*cur.HAPPEN_NUMBER > 0 ) TEMP WHERE TEMP.rn = 1 AND TEMP.offsetFlag = #{offsetFlag} /**冲正标识**/ )
SELECT crt.*,/**账务明细表（当前表）.全部项目**/ book.BOOKSET_DATE booksetDateNew /**账套日期表.账套日期**/ FROM BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT crt INNER JOIN voucher vr on crt.happen_date = vr.happenDate and crt.BOOKSET_DATE = vr.booksetDate and crt.BOOK_DATE = vr.bookDate and crt.BOOK_ID = vr.bookId and crt.bookset_id = vr.booksetId INNER JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_DATE book ON book.BOOKSET_ID = crt.BOOKSET_ID WHERE 1 =1
/**科目性质**/ AND crt.BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE IN
#{baseSubjectNature}
AND crt.BOK_DETAIL_ID = #{bokDetailId} /**账务明细代码**/
AND ( crt.HAPPEN_DATE <= #{onwayDate} AND crt.ONWAY_DATE > #{onwayDate})
ORDER BY crt.HAPPEN_DATE ASC

select * from BOK_FEE_TABLE_SET feeSet where 1=1
and feeSet.ps='T00'
and feeSet.ps!='T00'

select b.bookset_id as booksetId, /*账套代码*/ i.bok_detail_id bokDetailId,/*账务明细代码 */ i.busi_id busiId,/*业务明细代码 */ i.busi_detail_type busiDetailType,/*业务明细类型*/ i.branch,/*分支序号*/ i.lev,/*级别序号*/ b.standard_ccy as standardCcy, /*本位币*/ h.bookset_date as booksetDate, /*帐套日期*/ h.book_date as bookDate/*入账日期*/ from bok_bookset b inner join bok_batch_task_todo h on h.seq_no = #{seqNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and h.bookset_date =#{BOOKSET_DATE,jdbcType=DATE} and h.book_date =#{BOOK_DATE,jdbcType=DATE} and h.happen_date =#{HAPPEN_DATE,jdbcType=DATE} and h.task_id = #{taskId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and b.bookset_id = h.bookset_id AND h.IS_SUB_BOOKSET = #{IS_SUB_BOOKSET} inner join BOK_ACCT_LAYERING_INFO i on i.bookset_id = b.bookset_id where 1=1 and b.bok_spec_mode is not null
